title: ActionTransitionAllowlist
description: Shape of ./transitions.json: the allowlist of legal ActionState (from, to) pairs (Clarification 11). Any pair not listed is forbidden, including self-transitions and every move out of a terminal state; there is no deny list. PRP-17 enforces from this data. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by `validate_transition_allowlist` in tests/contracts/test_action_transitions.py: (from, to) pairs are unique, no pair has from == to, no pair starts at a terminal state, initial_state is not terminal, and every non-terminal state is reachable from initial_state and can reach a terminal state.

state_machine.description: Which state machine this allowlist governs.
